title: When entering DND mode hides already-visible notifications, exiting DND mode should not make them appear again
line: Notifications hidden when Do Not Disturb turns on now stay in the history instead of popping up again when it turns off.
explanation: Turning Do Not Disturb on only filtered normal popups out of the popup model; the notifications themselves stayed active. Turning it off removed the filter, so they popped up again and their timeout started over. Now, when Do Not Disturb turns on, every popup it is about to hide (not critical ones that are allowed in DND, whitelisted apps, user-action feedback or jobs) is marked expired, so it goes to the history as unread instead.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: send popups hidden by Do Not Disturb to history

Popups on screen when Do Not Disturb turned on were only hidden, so they
popped up again with a fresh timeout once it turned off. Mark them as
expired instead, so they stay in the history like any other popup.

BUG: 524749

media.caption: Master: a 30 s popup, Do Not Disturb on hides it, Do Not Disturb off brings it back with a fresh timeout.
Fixed: same steps, the popup stays hidden after Do Not Disturb turns off; the bell shows an unread notification.
Apps allowed to pop up in Do Not Disturb (Konsole here) keep their popup; the other app's popup goes to history.
The hidden notification is in the history.

review.text: Expiring the popups that Do Not Disturb hides is the right behaviour. But the QML re-implements the filter proxy's DND rules (urgency, whitelists, user-action feedback), and the whitelist check uses the raw desktop entry instead of Utils::settingsDesktopEntry. It also only works if onInhibitedChanged runs before the popup model's urgencies/whitelist bindings update and drop those rows, and QML doesn't guarantee that order. Note it also fires for automatic inhibition (fullscreen focus, mirrored screens), which seems acceptable.
changes: Move this into libnotificationmanager (e.g. a Notifications method next to showInhibitionSummary, or marking visible popups wasAddedDuringInhibition so showInhibitionSummary expires and counts them), so the existing filter logic is reused and there's no dependence on binding order
